game_concept: A puzzle set in Mt. Pyre – Obsidian Quarry, a glassy black quarry: the forge smith must handle smoke serpents while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Type Sorter: Sort falling fire gems into bins labelled int, float, str and bool before they hit the ground.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Obsidian Quarry: a glassy black quarry
core_gameplay_loop: In Obsidian Quarry, repeat each round: Sort falling fire gems into bins labelled int, float, str and bool before they hit the ground. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the sorted_ok value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the ember furnace using at most 19 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: The ember furnace reached with actions_used <= 19.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 19 before the ember furnace is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 2 (intro tier): Type Sorter
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Type Sorter' (Week 2 slot 1), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Obsidian Quarry'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how sorted_ok changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against smoke serpents in Obsidian Quarry.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The ember furnace reached with actions_used <= 19.
